dz: 西奥多拉被加冕为拜占庭皇后并和当时的皇帝特奥菲洛斯在哈吉亚索菲亚结婚. 她恢复了基督教正统和圣像.
de: Theodora is crowned Byzantine empress and marries then emperor Theophilos in the Hagia Sophia. She is credited with restoring Christian orthodoxy and icons.
